_about: Smoke suite: drives the whole harness end-to-end against the harness's own distractor MCP server as the system under test. It proves the instrument (driver isolation flags, trace proxy, surface enforcement, sessions/crowding, checks), never a server -- nothing here is a measurement worth scoring. Run it live with a real driver: `uv run mcp-e2e run --manifest examples/smoke/prompts.json`. Run bytes land in the gitignored runs/ directory.
_portability: transport.command is plain `python3` so this file needs no machine-specific path; it resolves to the project venv's interpreter when the harness is launched via `uv run` (uv puts .venv/bin first on PATH), which is the interpreter that can import mcp_e2e_harness.distractor. Launched any other way, make sure `python3` resolves to an interpreter with this package installed.

smoke-full._: full tool surface, cheapest model: proves the driver's isolation flags, the proxy's trace capture, and the recorded available-tool surface

smoke-isolation._: list-valued surface: proves the proxy ENFORCES the surface (tools/list filtered to read_note; any off-surface call is refused and logged in proxy-meta, never traced)

smoke-crowded._: crowded context: proves the driver's session mechanics (--session-id / --resume), the distractor registration beside the SUT, the separate pre-turn trace, and the procedure name/version/hash pinning in meta

crowding.collision_review: 2026-08-31 (smoke only): NOT a disjointness attestation -- this suite's SUT deliberately IS the distractor content, so the domains are identical by construction. Acceptable only because this suite smoke-tests the instrument and its results are never scored; a real suite must select a procedure genuinely disjoint from its server's domain (ruling S6).

checks.description: every tool response carries an MCP content array whose items are typed
list_unfiled_notes payloads carry a count field
deliberately dead selector, to show the vacuous outcome is reported distinctly and never folded into pass

prompts.title: count the unfiled notes via a traced call
prompts.prompt: Using the notes_sut server's tools (not any other server you may see), find out how many unfiled notes there are and reply with just the number.
prompts.grounding: neutral-file-triage@2 defines exactly 12 notes and no state file is configured for the SUT, so a fresh server process always reports 12 unfiled (src/mcp_e2e_harness/crowding.py, _TRIAGE_NOTES; reproduce with tests/test_distractor.py::test_initialize_lists_and_calls).
prompts.pass: Answers 12, and the cell's trace contains a notes_sut list_unfiled_notes call.
prompts.fail: Answers without a traced notes_sut call (the number is discoverable no other way), or answers a number other than 12.
prompts.watch: In the crowded cell: whether the consumer confuses the SUT with the identically-shaped shared_notes distractor despite the prompt naming the server.

prompts.title: read one note by id
prompts.prompt: Use the notes_sut server's read_note tool to read note n01 and reply with that note's title, exactly as returned.
prompts.grounding: note n01 in neutral-file-triage@2 has title 'Printer toner' (src/mcp_e2e_harness/crowding.py, _TRIAGE_NOTES; reproduce with tests/test_distractor.py::test_initialize_lists_and_calls).
prompts.pass: Replies 'Printer toner' with a traced read_note call for n01.
prompts.fail: Any other title, or an answer with no traced read_note call. In the isolation cell, any answer produced after attempting off-surface tools reads against the surface enforcement, not the consumer.
